$comment: What scripts/third-party.mjs accepts. `allow` is SPDX ids that are fine without review. `exceptions` is a package or ASSETS.md row by name, with why it is fine: add one only after reading the license. See docs/runbooks/third-party.md.

exceptions.remotion: Remotion License, not open source. Remotion gave Nekko Labs direct approval to use it (2026-11-03).
exceptions.@remotion/player: Remotion License, not open source. Remotion gave Nekko Labs direct approval to use it (2026-11-03).
exceptions.Remotion: The ASSETS.md row for the two packages above.
exceptions.elkjs: EPL-2.0, weak copyleft. Reaches us unmodified through mermaid, and its license and source link stay in the notices.
exceptions.khroma: MIT: the license file says so, package.json just omits the field.
exceptions.caniuse-lite: CC-BY-4.0. Build-time browser data, not shipped.
exceptions.exif-parser: MIT: the license file says so, package.json just omits the field. Build tool, not shipped.
